reason: A better addresses the stated limitations by extending HEA-reinforced friction-stir surface processing to TC4 as a solid-state alternative to defect-prone laser cladding, while providing relevant controls and falsification criteria. Its assumption that a refractory HEA filler will become uniformly nanoscale precipitates in TC4 requires verification, but B relies on the specifically problematic laser-cladding route and largely assumes that parameter optimization will eliminate residual stress, cracking, dilution, and intermetallic risks.
